assumptions: Structures are ranked on lowest total financing charges (interest + fees, not discounted). Residual value, tax, discounting of financing flows and per-period fees are not modelled; this is a screen, not an investment appraisal.
A structure is evaluated only at its facility's actual term. Any other term is a hypothetical illustration: it is never selected and never applied for.

Liquidity is tested day by day on current books: the purchase is paid on the day the loan proceeds land (request day + the facility's lead time), and the proceeds, the upfront fee and every scheduled payment post. A day below the reserve fails a structure when the structure makes that day's cash lower than the same day on current books without the purchase; a shortfall the books already have is reported beside it, not blamed on the structure. The owner's uplift is not counted as cash in that test.

Monthly debt service includes every balance already drawn on a facility that counts in debt service: an amortising facility at its annuity payment over its term, a bullet term loan at (principal + interest) / term (ADR-0008), a revolving line interest-only. Leverage is month-end debt (principal of existing debt + drawn balances that count in leverage) / (12 × monthly EBITDA), read from each structure's own projection; a committed line's undrawn room is not debt. The leverage figures before a structure is projected (financed, and with a terms extension funded) are labelled estimates. The upfront fee is a cash cost, not debt service.
Rates are nominal annual rates divided by 12 for monthly schedules, leases included; they are not effective annual rates.
The uplift is the owner's estimate and is treated as EBITDA in the DSCR test and as cash in NPV and payback; the system has not observed it.
